## User Stories

### Create Empty State Base Component
- **Story:** As a developer, I want to create a reusable empty state component so that I can consistently display when no data is available
- **Priority:** P1
- **Story Points:** 2
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] Component accepts message prop as string
  - [ ] Component accepts optional icon prop
  - [ ] Component uses design system typography and spacing
  - [ ] Component is centered in container
  - [ ] Component renders with role='status'
  - [ ] Component includes aria-label for accessibility

### Implement Empty State for Slow Steps
- **Story:** As a user, I want to see a clear message when there are no slow steps so that I understand why the section is empty
- **Priority:** P1
- **Story Points:** 1
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] Empty state shows 'No slow steps found' message
  - [ ] Component is responsive at all breakpoints
  - [ ] Component maintains consistent spacing within SlowStepsSection
  - [ ] Message is clearly visible and readable
  - [ ] Screen readers announce empty state appropriately

### Add Empty State Component Tests
- **Story:** As a developer, I want to have comprehensive tests for the empty state component so that I can ensure it works correctly
- **Priority:** P1
- **Story Points:** 2
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] Unit tests cover all props combinations
  - [ ] Accessibility tests verify ARIA attributes
  - [ ] Responsive behavior tests included
  - [ ] Integration tests with SlowStepsSection
  - [ ] Test coverage meets minimum threshold


## Non-Functional Requirements
- Performance: API response times < 200ms
- Security: Follow OWASP Top 10 guidelines
- Scalability: Support horizontal scaling
